touchGap.purpose: Boxes overlapping or closer than this (edge to edge, normalised to the frame) are 'touching'.
touchGap.ref: About one box-edge jitter of the fast detector at 320 px input.

nearRelativeGap.purpose: Two objects are 'near' when their edge gap is below this multiple of the reference size (square root of the larger box area). Scale-invariant, so it works close-up and far away.
nearRelativeGap.ref: Roughly a third of an object's size: a mug next to a laptop, not across the desk.

enabled.purpose: Liquid container touching or near an electronic device (attributes from the ontology).
enabled.ref: Classic desk hazard; attributes liquid_container and electronic are WordNet-derived.

severityTouching.purpose: Severity when the boxes touch or overlap.
severityTouching.ref: Overlap in the image often means the container stands on or against the device.

severityNear.purpose: Severity when near but not touching.

enabled.purpose: Food touching or near an electronic device.
enabled.ref: Crumbs and grease; attributes food and electronic.

enabled.purpose: A sharp tool left out (attribute sharp).
enabled.ref: Knives/scissors are only a problem when left lying around, hence the persistence requirement.

minPersistenceMs.purpose: Live Scan: the tool must be tracked this long (ignored for single images).
minPersistenceMs.ref: Excludes a knife being used and put away.

enabled.purpose: A liquid container standing near the edge of a detected surface (table/desk).
enabled.ref: Requires an object with the surface attribute; measured from box geometry.

edgeMargin.purpose: Distance from the container's base centre to the surface's left, right or front (bottom) edge that counts as 'at the edge'.
edgeMargin.ref: About a hand's width on a typical desk.

enabled.purpose: Many small objects in view (workspace density).
enabled.ref: Object-count proxy for visual clutter; perceptual clutter measures such as Feature Congestion (Rosenholtz et al., J. Vision 2007) need pixel statistics we do not model.

excludeAttributes.purpose: Large or living things are not counted as clutter.

minCountLow.purpose: LOW severity from this many countable objects.
minCountLow.ref: A tidy desk shows 3-6 detectable items.

minCountMedium.purpose: MEDIUM severity from this many countable objects.

enabled.purpose: Objects cover most of a detected surface (blocked work area).
enabled.ref: Union of object boxes inside the surface box / surface box area (rasterised).

minOccupancy.ref: Less than 40% free surface leaves no clear work area.

enabled.purpose: Several countable objects heavily overlapping each other (stacked or piled items).

minIou.purpose: IoU above which two objects count as stacked/overlapping.
minIou.ref: Same value as the fusion/unconfirmed association gate.

minPairs.purpose: Number of overlapping pairs before the finding is raised.
minPairs.ref: One overlap is normal (a cup in front of a laptop).

enabled.purpose: An animal touching or near electronics.
Several cable-like objects close together. Needs a detector whose vocabulary contains cables (attribute cable); never fires with the bundled COCO detectors.

minCables.purpose: Cables near each other before the finding is raised.

enabled.purpose: Liquid container near a power outlet. Needs a detector with an outlet category (attribute outlet).
Live Scan: an object stays heavily overlapped by others.
enabled.ref: Uses the scene model's per-object occlusion fraction.

minDurationMs.purpose: Time the object must stay occluded.

severity.ref: Context for other findings, not a bug by itself.

enabled.purpose: Live Scan: something covers most of the view (very dark frame or a single box covering most of the frame).

minBoxArea.purpose: Box area that counts as covering the view.

maxBrightness.purpose: Mean luminance below which the camera is considered covered.

minDurationMs.purpose: Duration before the finding is raised.

enabled.purpose: Scene too dark or too bright for reliable analysis and comfortable work.
enabled.ref: Mean luminance of the frame (Rec. 601 weights).

dark.purpose: Mean luminance below which the scene is 'low light'.
dark.ref: Detector recall drops visibly below this on test images.

bright.purpose: Mean luminance above which the scene is 'washed out'.

enabled.purpose: Image too blurred to analyse reliably.

minSharpness.purpose: Sharpness below which the frame is 'blurred'.
minSharpness.ref: Below the sharpness of all in-focus test images.

severity.ref: Scan quality, not a scene problem.

enabled.purpose: Live Scan: a food item or liquid container stays in the same place for a long time (left behind).
enabled.ref: Static, persistent track of an object with attribute food or liquid_container.

minDurationMs.purpose: Time the object must stay static.

enabled.purpose: Live Scan: an object is moved back and forth repeatedly.
enabled.ref: Direction reversals counted per track (temporal.json movement.reversalWindowMs).

severity.ref: Workflow observation (e.g. an item constantly in the way).

persistenceFullMs.purpose: Local finding confidence = mean detection confidence of the involved objects x (0.7 + 0.3 x min(1, persistence / this)).
persistenceFullMs.ref: Objects seen for longer are more trustworthy (temporal evidence).

severityWeights.purpose: Penalty per open finding: weight x (0.5 + 0.5 x confidence).

floor.ref: A score of 0 reads as 'broken', which is never justified by detections.

aiBlend.purpose: When an AI score exists: score = blend x AI score + (1 - blend) x computed score.

criticalBelow.purpose: Status CRITICAL below this score (or with an open CRITICAL finding).

degradedBelow.purpose: Status DEGRADED below this score (or with an open HIGH finding).
